title: Rain, After School
summary: The quiet one. Iris admits to the private index. Exercises: weather gate, relationship threshold, knowledge on both sides. Trust 10 is the maximum a run can reach, and only by being warm to Iris at the first shift AND curious about the photograph — so this scene is the payoff for two earlier decisions the player had no reason to think were connected.
